items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 50:1
items.html: Bina, although it is the discernment of a light of Hassadim, is nevertheless considered actual GAR, because Bina is the essence of Hochma — except that in the secret of "for He delights in mercy", she always longs only for the light of Hassadim. But in the world of Beriah, although Ima nests in Beriah and there is there the level of SAG, nevertheless it is not considered "actual GAR from the aspect of the essence of the GAR", like the Bina of Atzilut, which is the essence of Hochma, but only the discernment of the illumination of the GAR of Bina. For it is now not the essence of Hochma, because the Hassadim of Bina in Beriah were separated completely from the light of Hochma, by reason of the screen and the Parsa of Atzilut, which concludes upon the light of Hochma and does not allow the illumination of Hochma to pass to Beriah. Therefore these GAR in Beriah are discerned only "as GAR from the aspect of their illumination" alone, that is, there is no essence of the GAR of Bina here, because the GAR themselves do not expand to Beriah, but only their illumination alone, for there is in them only Hassadim separated from Hochma, by the power of the screen and restriction. (Item 205 and Item 209).
